entities.title: Cleaning log lines
entities.summary: With --log, the proxy writes one line per cleaned answer to its standard error: what it answered and the estimated tokens before and after.
entities.name: zazzled proxy: tools/call NAME ~A→~B tokens (or resources/read)
entities.meaning: One server answer whose texts were shortened, with the estimated size before and after.
entities.access: Whoever holds the proxy's standard error; for a stdio proxy that is usually the MCP client's log.
excludes: The texts themselves, request arguments and answers that were not shortened are not logged.

entities.title: HTTP listen line
entities.summary: In HTTP mode the proxy writes `zazzled proxy: http://ADDR → URL` to standard error once it listens.
entities.name: zazzled proxy: http://ADDR → URL
entities.meaning: The proxy is listening on ADDR (with the port the system chose, if 0 was asked) and forwards to URL.
entities.access: Whoever holds the proxy's standard error.
